comparisons.reason: Feature 0 requires an analogy or comparison to a named, specific real-world case, used to argue against the OP. Feature 75 (local 1) requires only that a comment cite a specific real-world example (event, person, study, place, etc.) to support or illustrate its argument. Citing an example is broader than drawing an analogy to one, and it has no against-the-OP requirement. A comment can cite a real case as direct evidence without making an analogy, so the two row functions can give different 0/1 results. Both use OC_comments, are binary, and share the same null and empty rules.
